descriptions.r23c_set_high_flag_80348e1c: Set bit 31 of the word at offset 48 from the low input bit and return zero.
descriptions.r23c_max_byte_80352828: Return the first unsigned maximum byte in a half-open range, or its start when empty.
descriptions.r23c_rgb_to_opaque_803563b8: Copy three byte channels and set the fourth channel to 255.
descriptions.r23c_expand_1555_8035642c: Expand three packed five-bit channels by shifting three bits and map the high bit to alpha zero or 255.
descriptions.r23c_history_append_80358144: Append two words to parallel 128-entry rings, increment the index, update the unsigned peak, and return zero.
